Title: sumMap for record but not aggregate
Description: Hi
  I have a table named test,the data like below
```
id payMode.code  payMode.fee name ...
1  [100,100,200]  [10,20,30] name1 ...
2  [100,200,100]  [10,20,30] name2 ...
```
now I want get the result 
```
id payMode.code  payMode.fee name ...
1  [100,200]  [30,30] name1 ...
2  [100,200]  [40,20] name2 ...
```

I want to sumMap the payMode.code for every record using 
```
select summap(payMode.code,payMode.fee) as payMode,id,name,... from test
```
but it get the exception id,name is not in aggregate, is there any way sumMap for every record but not aggregate.
I know I can use sumMap and group by to complete it ,but it's more complicated
